subject.title: WORKING: All Microsoft Issues and PRs (refresh)

question: Should the Microsoft-wide inventory become a committed root artifact with a PR-body mutation tool, or remain an external or ephemeral maintainer tracking surface?
rationale: The patch creates a permanent cross-area administrative source of truth and recurring maintenance burden; code correctness cannot determine whether that product and ownership boundary belongs in main.

options.title: Keep Tracker Outside Main
options.body: Use a GitHub Project, saved searches, or a working PR body as the canonical inventory instead of committing volatile generated state.

options.title: Sponsor Repository Tracker
options.body: Assign an owner and require a generator/check pair, safe body rendering, a refresh cadence, and current-head live proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep Tracker Outside Main
recommendation.body: Use a GitHub Project, saved searches, or a working PR body as the canonical inventory instead of committing volatile generated state.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent repository history connects this account most directly to generated-PR automation and repository-level ownership decisions.
